name: Noah Berman
headline: Software Engineer and Commercial Pilot
availability: Open to aviation and aerospace software roles in Boulder, San Francisco and abroad.
summary: I am a commercial pilot who writes software. I have built scheduling, maintenance and grounding logic for flight schools, a preflight briefing service, and the owner portal for an aircraft management company. I talk with the people who operate aircraft, build what fits how they work, and check the aviation math against the source. I work in English and Spanish.

experience.title: Software Consultant
bullets: Run discovery with small business owners in restaurants, hospitality and education, turning POS, scheduling and back-office needs into custom software and AI workflows.

Built alone and support a phone-first shift checklist app in use at Smoothie King stores in Denver, replacing paper checklists with QR access, POS PIN sign-in, position-based tasks, manager sign-off and timestamped owner reporting.
Defined the app's requirements through staff interviews and live-shift observation. Built on Next.js and Supabase with PostgreSQL row-level security.
Build with automated tests, AI-assisted code review and deployment evals.

experience.title: Co-Founder
bullets: Co-founded an aircraft management and concierge company for owner-pilots at Centennial Airport with two partners.
Built and deployed the company's software platform and aircraft owner portal for scheduling and billing, used by clients, flight instructors and mechanics.
Managed customer relationships, aircraft operations, hangar partnerships, marketing, finances and accounting.

experience.title: Spanish and English Teacher
bullets: Taught English to adult Spanish speakers and Spanish to adult English speakers, working in both languages daily.
Built a bilingual learning platform with lesson content, progress tracking and staff tools, including a live AI voice conversation partner.

experience.title: Commission Sales Associate
bullets: Sold furniture on commission in person and online.
Created 3D furniture visualizations with the COOHOM API and built Adobe InDesign price-sign templates populated with MAP data.

experience.title: Software Engineering Intern
bullets: Promoted from paid intern to programmer.
Developed VR and interactive 3D experiences in Unity and C# with senior software engineers.
Unit testing and debugging, validated JSON scene configurations, and edited 360-degree video and imagery.

projects.name: Aviation operations platform
bullets: Interviewed flight school and FBO operators at Centennial and Rocky Mountain Metro airports.
Built and deployed a multi-tenant platform to production for scheduling, aircraft readiness, maintenance tracking and billing.
Engine monitoring against manufacturer limits with telemetry-based grounding rules, MEL handling, and an immutable squawk log with a full audit trail.

NestJS, GraphQL, Prisma and PostgreSQL backend with tenant isolation, role-based permissions and a database-backed notification queue. End-to-end tests against a live database, packaged in Docker with GitHub Actions builds.

projects.name: Preflight briefing automation
bullets: Built a Python FastAPI briefing service with Telegram delivery and deterministic weight-and-balance calculations.
Checked the aviation calculations against source documents in code review, catching and correcting a fabricated Vyse adjustment formula and an empty-weight error.

projects.name: iNoah and noahiberman.com
bullets: Built a bilingual React and TypeScript site with a retrieval-augmented assistant that answers questions about my work, plus a flight log map synced nightly from ForeFlight exports.
Runs on Supabase Edge Functions with hourly Google Drive ingestion into pgvector and public and private visibility enforced in SQL.
Deterministic low-confidence refusals, and deployment gates that use held-out evaluations to fail builds on prohibited claims.

projects.name: The Cooler Scooter
bullets: Proposed the concept selected for the final frame and ice-holding seat on a four-person team.
Modeled the knee seat in SolidWorks, integrated teammates' parts into a 20% scale assembly, 3D printed it, and ran turning and obstacle-clearance tests.

aircraft: Cessna 172, 182T, T182T, Cirrus SR20, SR22T, Piper PA-28-181, Beechcraft Baron 55, Beechcraft Travel Air, American Champion Decathlon, Robinson R44
flightExperience: Cessna high-wing singles, from the G1000 172S to the 182T and turbocharged T182T.
Cross-country out of Rocky Mountain Metro (KBJC) and Centennial (KAPA) across Colorado, Wyoming and Montana.
Mountain and high density altitude flying, regularly into Aspen, plus Leadville, Telluride, Eagle and Steamboat Springs.
Single-pilot IFR under the Denver Class B, with filing, clearances, approaches and holds in actual conditions.
Multi-engine commercial training in the Baron 55, now flying a Beechcraft Travel Air as pilot in command.
Glass and legacy panels: Garmin G1000, Cirrus Perspective and a conventional six-pack.
Helicopter add-on in the Robinson R44.
